messages:
Rae (PM): RetailPilot asks for a "Spend Deep Dive" card in Console they can include in an exec pack. They want: (1) clear top-5 routes driving spend deltas, (2) quick root-cause tag (tokens/model/traffic/error), (3) 2 tiny trace envelopes per flagged route, and (4) export CSV/PDF. Keep PII out. Can we scope an MVP?

Tomo (Eng): MVP sounds good. Implementation sketch: periodic delta job (compare last 7d vs previous 7d), derived metrics for tokens/calls/errors, serve a small card. Trace envelope = {trace_id, route, short_err, token_summary, model_hint} only. Envelope payload <600B.

Maya (SRE): Ops constraints: default envelope sampling 0.2%, retention 72h, per-org envelope quota 4k/day. Add auto-throttle: if envelopes/sec > org_baseline*3 -> reduce sampling 10x and notify. Also provide an incident toggle to disable envelopes immediately.

Dee (Data): Cost estimate approach: est = (tokens_in + tokens_out) * model_unit_cost(profile) + call_overhead. We'll run a classifier to label route as "textgen" or "embeddings" and show a confidence badge. For embeddings-heavy routes show an "accuracy warning" in UI. We'll also compute a simple variance vs Billing weekly for reconciliation.

Luca (UX): Card layout: headline delta ($ +/-%), three small driver bars (tokens, model, calls), tiny timeline with deploy markers, and a compact table of top routes. Trace envelopes are expandable one-line rows with a "Request raw traces" CTA leading to controlled SE flow. Export button -> CSV/PDF snapshot. Tooltip copy: "Estimates are for diagnostics, not billing."

Rae (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria: (A) Card shows top-5 delta routes with $ est and driver tags; (B) Deploy overlay visible; (C) Up to 2 envelopes/flagged route appear (no PII); (D) Per-org sampling controls + retention config in Console; (E) Pilot with RetailPilot completed and no p95 latency regression; (F) Export CSV/PDF available. Owners: Tomo -> backend + trace hook, Dee -> estimator + classifier, Maya -> alerts & kill-switch, Luca -> UI + export, Rae -> pilot coordination.

Tomo (Eng): Feature flag example: 
```yaml
console:
  spend_deep_dive:
    enabled: true
    delta_window_days: 7
    envelope:
      enabled: true
      default_sampling: 0.002   # 0.2%
      per_org_quota_per_day: 4000
      retention_days: 3
      max_payload_bytes: 600
```
We'll gate heavy work behind the flag so we can canary.

Maya (SRE): Alerts to add: `console.deepdive.envelope_surge` (envelopes/sec > baseline*3) and `console.deepdive.p95_regress` (p95 > 1.2x baseline). Also auto-throttle policy implemented server-side.

Dee (Data): UX microcopy: "Estimated spend computed from token counts and model profiles; intended for investigation, not invoicing. Embeddings-heavy routes may be undercounted." We'll surface a confidence % and a small link to "How estimates are computed."

Luca (UX): Export options: CSV (columns: route, est_dollars, pct_change, driver_tag, confidence) and PDF snapshot of the card. We'll hide any trace detail in export unless customer requests via SE.

Rae (PM): Next steps: Tomo to spike delta job + small proto, Dee to prototype estimator with classifier, Maya to draft alert thresholds, Luca to mock card and export flow. Pilot kickoff with RetailPilot next Tue. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: New alert templates created: `console.deepdive.envelope_surge` and `console.deepdive.p95_regress`.
